text.title: Error Handling (RFC 7807 Problem Details) Procedure
text.summary: Ten steps: five to produce the spec artefact from typed inputs, five to implement the envelope the artefact commits to.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `eh-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/error-handling.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact

section.title: Implementation steps (turning the artefact into a live envelope)

step.name: declare-type-uris
step.input: The list of error classes the API returns (validation, auth, not-found, rate-limit, internal).
step.action: Define a stable URI namespace `https://api.example.com/errors/<slug>` and document each (`type`, `title`, `status`) triple in the OpenAPI `components/responses`.
step.decision-gate: If the team cannot commit to URI stability, stop — the methodology requires that guarantee (rule r-type-uri-is-contract).

step.name: model-problem-detail
step.action: Define one ProblemDetail type (Pydantic BaseModel / TypeScript interface / Java record) carrying type, title, status, detail, instance, traceId, errors[].
step.output: One model file in a shared module.
step.decision-gate: The model must serialize unknown extension fields permissively (`additionalProperties: true` at schema level) so a later extension is not a breaking change.

step.name: register-one-handler
step.input: ProblemDetail model + the framework's exception hook.
step.action: Register a single framework-level exception handler catching every unhandled exception and returning ProblemDetail with `Content-Type: application/problem+json`. Delete per-route handlers.
step.output: One handler file; zero per-route error shapes.
step.decision-gate: Add a CI grep blocking `JSONResponse(content={"error":` and equivalents after this step (rules r-single-mapper, r-content-type-problem-json).

step.name: propagate-trace-id
step.action: Read the W3C `traceparent` header; generate a UUID when absent. Set it on the response body and the log line, and send `traceparent` on outbound cross-service calls.
step.output: Updated handler + middleware guaranteeing a trace context per request.
step.decision-gate: An error response without traceId blocks (rule r-trace-id-required).

step.name: contract-test
step.input: `templates/problem-details.schema.yaml` + every error path in the API.
step.action: Author an integration test hitting each error path and validating body AND content-type against the schema, including the body-status vs HTTP-status match.
step.decision-gate: Any endpoint failing the schema blocks the deploy; fix the shape before merging.
